newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Henkel gets $1.2 bln loan for Loctite bid.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Henkel gets $1.2 bln loan for Loctite bid.

text.p: LONDON, November 6 (LPC) - German consumer group Henkel KGaA has a $1.2 billion bridge loan to help fund its $57.25 per share bid for the 65 percent of US adhesives maker Loctite Corp it does not already own, according to a source close to the company.
Dresdner Bank is arranging the credit.
Launched Wednesday, the hostile bid is worth around $1.2 billion. Loctite has advised shareholders to wait for the conclusion of a special panel of its directors before acting on the offer.
Analysts told Reuters earlier Wednesday that, depending on the financing it gets, there is still room for Henkel to make a higher bid if need be.
Pricing of the bridge loan is set at 25 bps over LIBOR with a commitment fee of 6 bps. The expiry date for the credit is May 31, 1997.
Dresdner Bank officials declined to comment.
